pdg_001_nested_raw_data_tags_finding.description: In `gomate_places_freeze_v2.json`, 621/759 places (59/60 target POIs; all except Bãi biển Mỹ Khê) store OSM tags nested under `raw_data.tags`, whereas `apps/ai-service/app/rag/osm_documents.py` (`_tags()`) currently reads only flat top-level `raw_data` keys.

wikivoyage_audit.attribution_requirement: Wikivoyage contributors via Wikimedia REST API (`https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/<Title>`), CC-BY-SA-3.0

local_raw_parquet_enrichment_diagnostic.note: In git-tracked `data/curated/gomate_places_freeze_v2.json`, Overture `raw_data` retains only matching provenance (`overture_id`, `overture_name`, `distance_m`, `similarity_score`, `operating_status: null`, `license`, `providers`) and omits `addresses`, `phones`, and `websites`. Therefore, committed Freeze v2 Overture records are classified `LOW_INFORMATION` (`RAG_CANDIDATE_ELIGIBLE = false`) in B1A until rich fields from the local raw parquet are explicitly promoted into git-tracked documents.

overture_auto_link_target_26_pois.note: Committed Freeze v2 `raw_data` stores only matching provenance (`LOW_INFORMATION`); local git-ignored raw parquet holds `addresses=26`, `phones=22`, `websites=15`.

min_10_pois_per_city_with_rag_eligible_e.failing_city: Hạ Long (only 7/20 POIs have RAG-candidate-eligible structured OSM evidence; 13/20 are LOW_INFORMATION)

min_2_independent_provenance_bound_linea.reason: Only 26/60 POIs (Hà Nội=7, Đà Nẵng=10, Hạ Long=9) have 2 mapped entity lineages (OSM + Overture AUTO_LINK), below the >=30 overall and >=10/city thresholds, and 0/60 POIs have >=2 RAG-candidate-eligible document lineages.

min_150_useful_poi_mapped_chunks.reason: Only 40 POI-mapped OSM units contain useful structured facts (`0` POI-mapped narrative chunks; the 464 Wikivoyage chunks are unmapped city/country guides with `place_id = None`).

blocking_deficiencies: Zero POI-mapped narrative documents (`POIS_WITH_NARRATIVE_TEXT = 0/60`); all 464 Wikivoyage chunks have `place_id = None` (`157` `CITY_CONTEXT_ONLY`, `307` `UNMAPPED_TO_FROZEN_POI`).
Hạ Long has only `7/20` POIs with useful structured OSM facts (`13/20` are `LOW_INFORMATION` with only name, category tag, and coordinates), failing the `>=10` POIs/city minimum.
Only `26/60` POIs (`7` Hà Nội, `10` Đà Nẵng, `9` Hạ Long) have `>=2` independent mapped lineages (`OSM` + `Overture AUTO_LINK`), and `0/60` have `>=2` `RAG_CANDIDATE_ELIGIBLE` document lineages.
Only `40` POI-mapped useful structured units exist against the `>=150` useful-chunk minimum.

Ingestion bug `PDG-001` in `apps/ai-service/app/rag/osm_documents.py`: `_tags()` reads flat `raw_data` keys without unwrapping `raw_data['tags']`, causing `59/60` target POIs (`621/759` Freeze v2 POIs) to drop nested OSM tags during chunk rendering unless unwrapped.
